body.text: A better month, and I make a point of saying so, having been so free with the other kind of letter.

The returns are still only {perception:purse}. It is the direction of them I am writing about and not the figure, and the direction has been noticed in this office. I have seen to it that it was noticed elsewhere.
The returns are still only {perception:purse}. I record the improvement. I do not propose to make more of it than that.
I would not ease off. A colony that has climbed once is a colony that has shown it can, and you will find that is remembered as an expectation rather than as a credit.
